## Services

AL MARWA CO coordinates land freight, FTL and LTL movements, FCL and LCL sea freight, air cargo, heavy lifting, project cargo, customs-facing documentation, and international shipment planning. B2B planning can support recurring commercial lanes, corporate procurement inquiries, and complex project requirements. Service availability, pricing, routing, timing, and required documents are confirmed for each shipment.

## Accuracy notes

- The office address is Khalde Highway, Lebanon; the company serves businesses in Beirut and Greater Beirut without claiming a Beirut office.
- No testimonials, ratings, certifications, guaranteed transit times, or guaranteed customs outcomes should be inferred unless explicitly published and verified by AL MARWA CO.
